title: Estimate Geometric Transformation
text: Estimate geometric transformation from matching point pairs, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, {Transformation type} sets Transformation type; {Find and exclude outliers}, {Method}, {Algebraic distance threshold for determining inliers}, {Distance threshold for determining inliers (in pixels)}, {Determine number of random samplings using}, {Number of random samplings}, {Desired confidence (in %)}, {Maximum number of random samplings}, {Stop sampling earlier when a specified percentage of point pairs are determined to be inlier}, {Perform additional iterative refinement of the transformation matrix}, {Output Boolean signal indicating which point pairs are inliers}, {When Pts1 and Pts2 are built-in integers, set transformation matrix date type to} sets the transformation matrix date and {Allow variable-sized signal input}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Transformation type
params.values: Transformation type Affine (default) | Nonreflective similarity | Projective

params.name: Find and exclude outliers
params.values: Find and exclude outliers on (default) | off

params.name: Method
params.values: Method to find outliers RANdom SAmple Consensus (RANSAC) (default) | Least Median of Squares

params.name: Algebraic distance threshold for determining inliers
params.values: Algebraic distance threshold for determining inliers 1.5 (default) | scalar

params.name: Distance threshold for determining inliers (in pixels)
params.values: Distance threshold for determining inliers (in pixels) 1.5 (default) | scalar

params.name: Determine number of random samplings using
params.values: Determine number of random samplings using Specified value (default) | Desired confidence

params.name: Maximum number of random samplings
params.values: Maximum number of random samplings 1000 (default) | integer

params.name: Stop sampling earlier when a specified percentage of point pairs are determined to be inlier
Perform additional iterative refinement of the transformation matrix
params.values: Perform additional iterative refinement off (default) | on

params.name: Output Boolean signal indicating which point pairs are inliers

params.values: Set transformation matrix date type Single (default) | Double
